code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows hypoxemia, pancytopenia (anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia), and mild hypoproteinemia. Neutropenia with relative monocytosis and basophilia are noted. Glucose is slightly low. Liver and kidney function are within normal limits except for mildly low AST. Findings suggest possible bone marrow suppression or infiltration; clinical correlation and further hematological evaluation are recommended.
